use_case: Customer-service chatbot with account access (web and app chat) that answers billing, outage, and plan questions and takes limited account actions through the BSS API
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (SaaS on a large language model platform)
build_or_buy: Buy (configured with company knowledge articles and a BSS API connector)
data_categories: Customer messages; account data including CPNI (call detail, voice plan, bills); chat transcripts
consequential_decision_category: None (payment arrangement offers come from fixed BSS rules; credits, deposits, and disconnections stay with agents)
human_in_the_loop: Agents handle all credits, adjustments, disputes, and authentication changes; customers can reach a person at any time; account changes need customer confirmation
applicable_laws: 47 CFR 64.2007 and 64.2010(c), (e) (C-COMMUNICATIONS-R01); 64.2011 for any unauthorized disclosure; FTC Act Section 5 for broadband claims; Fla. Stat. 501.171 if Florida-defined personal information is exposed
status: Pilot approved with conditions (COO 2026-09-04); quick help disabled 2026-07-31; upsell to be disabled by 2026-10-15

use_case: General-purpose generative AI tools used by staff to draft emails, scripts, and documents
data_categories: Risk that staff paste CPNI, call detail, network configurations, or lawful-intercept information
risk_tier: High (if CPNI or network data is entered); Low otherwise
applicable_laws: 47 U.S.C. 222 and 47 CFR 64.2010(a) (disclosure of CPNI to an unapproved third party); CALEA SSI confidentiality (47 CFR 1.20003)
status: Prohibited for CPNI and Confidential data (POL-05 4.9); enterprise tool with data protection terms under evaluation
